lines.21656948817920: You can use the phone to save your progress as well as call other contacts you meet in the world. Making a call with a payphone costs $1.
lines.21656948817922: Open Inventory to turn on the flashlight. The flashlight greatly increases vision in dark areas when turned on but will consume charge while active. Combine with Batteries to recharge the flashlight.
lines.21656953012225: Drop down from ledges to avoid fall damage. Press Down to hang from a ledge. Then again to drop down.
lines.21656953012227:
Use the <color="white>transfer</color> action to move items between your inventory and storage.

Inventory space is very limited, only bring the essentials.
lines.21656953012229: You can perform two types of attack with melee weapons. Tap {input_0} to perform a quick attack. Hold {input_0} to charge an overhead swing.
lines.21656953012231: Open Inventory to equip melee weapons such as the boxcutter. Select the weapon, then use the Equip option to equip it.
lines.21656953012235:
Keys in your inventory can be <color="white>combined</color> with the keyring to save space in your inventory.
 
<color="white>Use</color> the keyring to access your stored keys.
lines.21656953012237: Tap {input_0} while moving in a direction to move past enemies.
lines.21656953012239: Press Reload while aiming to begin reloading. Press Reload again while inside the highlighted area to insert ammunition.
lines.20655143739584512: Hold {input_0} to aim weapons and then use {input_1} to fire. It is only possible to aim while a ranged weapon is Equipped.
lines.21071908256739328: Melee weapons will take damage after use and will eventually break. Broken weapons are much less effective. It is possible to repair a weapon by combining it with repair items such as Duct Tape.
lines.49012903992487936: While using the Aim action press the Secondary Action action to use (throw) the item.
lines.91055962623963136: Important documents found are added to the map and can be reviewed later.
lines.96861441174401024: Julee the Waitress can help you identify Mementos found in the world. Once identified, Mementos can be equipped and provide enhancements. Unlock more Memento Slots by providing Julee with Identify Documents found in the world.

Combined healing items for a more potent effect and to free up item space in inventory.
